name: OGG 监控 — GoldenGate 状态监控方法
description: GoldenGate 监控体系的建设和使用。覆盖进程状态监控、lag 监控、heartbeat 表配置、自动告警设置、与企业监控系统集成。良好的监控是 OGG 稳定运行的基础。

conditions.desc: 需要建立或检查 OGG 监控

skip_when.desc: OGG Microservices 架构自带监控

root_causes.name: 无进程状态监控
root_causes.desc: 未配置自动检查 Extract/Replicat 状态的监控，进程 ABEND 后无人知晓。

root_causes.name: 无 lag 监控
root_causes.desc: 未配置 lag 阈值告警，复制延迟持续增长无人关注。

root_causes.name: 未配置 heartbeat 表
root_causes.desc: heartbeat 表是端到端延迟最准确的衡量。未配置时只能依赖 GGSCI LAG 命令的估算。

root_causes.name: 未与企业监控集成
root_causes.desc: OGG 监控未接入 Zabbix/Prometheus/OEM 等企业级监控平台。

step1_check_heartbeat.desc: 检查 heartbeat 表是否配置
step1_check_heartbeat.sql: SELECT table_name FROM DBA_TABLES WHERE table_name LIKE 'GGS_HEARTBEAT%' ORDER BY table_name

step2_check_heartbeat_data.desc: 检查 heartbeat 最新数据
step2_check_heartbeat_data.sql: SELECT source_name, target_name, heartbeat_timestamp, incoming_heartbeat_ts, EXTRACT(SECOND FROM (incoming_heartbeat_ts - heartbeat_timestamp)) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (incoming_heartbeat_ts - heartbeat_timestamp))*60 lag_seconds FROM GGS_HEARTBEAT_HISTORY WHERE heartbeat_timestamp > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR ORDER BY heartbeat_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step3_check_manager.desc: 检查 Manager 自动重启配置
step3_check_manager.sql:
-- Manager 参数检查:
-- AUTOSTART EXTRACT *
-- AUTOSTART REPLICAT *
-- AUTORESTART EXTRACT *, RETRIES 3, WAITMINUTES 5
-- AUTORESTART REPLICAT *, RETRIES 3, WAITMINUTES 5
SELECT 'Check Manager parameter file for AUTOSTART and AUTORESTART' AS action FROM dual

step4_check_purge.desc: 检查 trail 自动清理配置
step4_check_purge.sql:
-- Manager 参数:
-- PURGEOLDEXTRACTS <trail_path>, USECHECKPOINTS, MINKEEPFILES 3
SELECT 'Check Manager params for PURGEOLDEXTRACTS' AS action FROM dual
